details.en: Returns use the original sale’s prices, discounts and taxes. Shop reduces that invoice’s outstanding amount first, then allocates any excess to the original payments. Choose resellable or damaged stock; service returns do not restore consumed materials. Cash refunds are recorded after cash handover. Historical sales without sufficient original records are unavailable for partial returns.
